projectOverview.pageType: Travel booking and destination discovery landing page
projectOverview.purpose: Present a travel agency, promote destinations and services, explain the booking process, show customer feedback, and encourage visitors to subscribe.
projectOverview.visualDirection: Elegant editorial travel interface with a light background, warm orange calls to action, purple accents, destination photography, soft shadows, and decorative geometric details.
projectOverview.primaryAudience: People researching and booking leisure travel.

pageDimensions.contentAlignment: Most content is centered inside a wide desktop canvas with a primary content area beginning around 148px to 186px from the left edge.
pageDimensions.coordinateNote: The Figma design contains decorative layers that extend beyond the visible page bounds. Negative positions are intentional for those decorative layers.

pageSections.name: Hero
pageSections.purpose: Introduce the travel service, communicate the main value proposition, and provide the first booking-related actions.
pageSections.layout: Two-column desktop composition. Navigation sits at the top. Text content occupies the left side and a large traveller illustration occupies the right side.
pageSections.visualStyling: White or very light background with pale decorative shapes and a large angled purple decoration toward the upper-right area.

pageSections.name: Services
pageSections.purpose: Explain the main travel services offered by the agency.
pageSections.layout: Centered heading followed by four service categories arranged horizontally.
pageSections.visualStyling: Mostly open space with one emphasized service card. Small plus-sign decoration appears near the upper-right edge.

pageSections.name: Destinations
pageSections.purpose: Show popular travel destinations with imagery, pricing, and trip duration.
pageSections.layout: Centered section label and heading above three equal destination cards in a horizontal row.
pageSections.visualStyling: Large rounded destination images with a white information panel attached at the bottom. Cards use soft depth and clean spacing.
childElements: Decorative vertical shape at the right edge

pageSections.name: Book A Trip
pageSections.purpose: Explain how customers can complete a booking in three simple steps and reinforce the service with a trip summary card.
pageSections.layout: Two-column section. Steps are stacked on the left. A large trip preview card and smaller ongoing-trip card overlap on the right.
pageSections.visualStyling: White cards with generous rounded corners, subtle shadows, circular icon backgrounds, and a pale decorative ellipse behind the illustration.
childElements: Book your next trip in 3 easy steps heading
Reach Airport on Selected Date step

pageSections.name: Testimonials
pageSections.purpose: Build trust by showing customer feedback and identity details.
pageSections.layout: Text block on the left and layered testimonial cards on the right, with vertical pagination controls at the far right.
pageSections.visualStyling: Large dark heading, white elevated card in front, lighter bordered card behind, circular profile image, and minimal pagination.
childElements: What people say about Us heading

pageSections.name: Partner Logos
pageSections.purpose: Display trusted travel or business partners.
pageSections.layout: Five partner logo placements distributed across one horizontal row.
pageSections.visualStyling: Logo images use muted or luminosity treatment. One center logo sits inside a white rounded rectangle with a soft shadow.

pageSections.name: Subscription
pageSections.purpose: Collect an email address for travel news, offers, and updates.
pageSections.layout: Large centered subscription panel with heading above an email field and submit button.
pageSections.visualStyling: Very pale purple rounded panel with a distinct asymmetric corner, faint circular line decorations, and an accent send icon in the upper-right.

pageSections.name: Footer
pageSections.purpose: Provide brand context, secondary navigation, social links, app download links, and copyright information.
pageSections.layout: Brand description at left, three navigation columns in the center, and social/app download controls on the right. Copyright is centered below.
pageSections.visualStyling: Open white footer with restrained text colors and a large pale decorative ellipse extending beyond the right edge.

navigation.position: Top of the hero, approximately 47px (2.9375rem) from the design top.
navigation.layout: Horizontal navigation aligned within a wide centered container.
navigation.logo: Jadoo wordmark positioned at the far left.
navigation.mobileRecommendation: Collapse navigation items into a menu button and retain the logo plus the primary sign-up action.

hero.headlineTreatment: Very large dark navy serif-style display heading with a purple accent stroke or decoration crossing the headline area.
hero.supportingCopy: Short muted paragraph explaining that the service helps customers discover and book trips.

primaryCta.label: Find out more
primaryCta.style: Warm orange fill, white text, rounded corners.

secondaryCta.label: Play Demo
secondaryCta.style: Text label paired with a circular play button.

cardsAndComponents.purpose: Present destination image, title, trip duration, and price.
cardsAndComponents.style: Rounded image area with a white bottom information panel.

cardsAndComponents.purpose: Present one travel service with an icon, title, and description.
cardsAndComponents.style: Mostly open card layout; the Best Flights variant is emphasized with a white elevated card.
White surface, 26px radius, soft shadow, trip image, metadata, and action icons.

cardsAndComponents.purpose: Show progress for another active trip.
cardsAndComponents.style: White surface, 18px radius, avatar, progress bar, and status text.

cardsAndComponents.purpose: Display a review and customer identity.
cardsAndComponents.style: White surface, 10px radius, subtle shadow, profile image, and muted body text.
Small circular or rounded icon control.

cardsAndComponents.purpose: Link to a mobile app store.
cardsAndComponents.style: Compact dark or branded download badge.

buttonsAndCtas.label: Sign up
buttonsAndCtas.style: Outlined or lightly bordered navigation button

imagesAndIllustrations.assetLocation: All local image and SVG assets are stored in the assets/ directory.

fontFamilies.usage: Navigation, labels, body copy, buttons, card metadata, and footer text

hierarchy: Hero heading: approximately 84px (5.25rem), Volkhov Bold, line height approximately 89px (5.5625rem).
Subscription heading: approximately 33px (2.0625rem), Poppins SemiBold, line height 54px (3.375rem).
Footer brand title: approximately 44px (2.75rem), Poppins Medium.
Body copy: approximately 16px (1rem), Poppins Regular, line height approximately 19.92px (1.245rem).
Footer navigation headings: approximately 21px (1.3125rem), Poppins Bold.
Footer navigation links: approximately 18px (1.125rem), Poppins Medium.

spacingAndLayout.sectionRhythm: Large vertical gaps separate the major sections, typically 400px to 700px between section starts.
spacingAndLayout.cardGap: Destination cards are separated by approximately 35px (2.1875rem).
spacingAndLayout.contentColumns: Desktop sections commonly use a 50/50 or 45/55 split between text and visual content.
spacingAndLayout.alignment: Headings and labels are frequently centered for Services and Destinations, while Hero, Booking, and Testimonials use left-aligned text blocks.
spacingAndLayout.positioning: Use relative section wrappers with absolute positioning only for decorative artwork and intentional overlapping cards.
spacingAndLayout.recommendedMaxWidth: Approximately 1160px to 1200px (72.5rem to 75rem) for primary desktop content.

borderRadius.destinationCards: Rounded image and card corners; approximately 20px to 24px (1.25rem to 1.5rem).
borderRadius.subscriptionPanel: 20px (1.25rem) with one enlarged asymmetric corner around 129px (8.0625rem).

shadowsAndEffects.cardShadow: Very soft, broad shadow with approximately 0.01 to 0.02 opacity, spread over a large vertical distance.
shadowsAndEffects.featuredServiceShadow: Subtle elevation around the highlighted Best Flights card.
shadowsAndEffects.tripCardShadow: Soft layered shadow beneath the main trip card and ongoing trip card.
shadowsAndEffects.logoShadow: Soft shadow behind the center partner logo container.
shadowsAndEffects.imageTreatment: Partner logos use muted luminosity or grayscale-like treatment.
shadowsAndEffects.decorativeOpacity: Subscription circular patterns and background decorations use low opacity, approximately 10% to 20%.

responsiveObservations.desktop: The source is optimized for a 1440px desktop canvas with wide horizontal navigation and multi-column sections.
responsiveObservations.tablet: Reduce horizontal gutters, allow destination cards to wrap, and scale the hero illustration while keeping the text readable.
responsiveObservations.mobile: Stack hero text above the image, collapse navigation into a menu, stack service and destination cards, and place booking cards below the steps.
responsiveObservations.typography: Use responsive reductions for the hero heading and section headings rather than allowing overflow.
responsiveObservations.decorations: Hide or reposition oversized decorative ellipses, plus-sign grids, and airplane shapes on narrow screens.
responsiveObservations.forms: Stack the email input and Subscribe button vertically below approximately 600px viewport width.
responsiveObservations.footer: Convert footer columns into stacked groups or a two-column mobile layout.

importantFigmaAssets.note: Asset filenames refer to the local files inside assets/.

suggestedHtmlCssStructure.heroMarkup: header.site-header > a.logo + nav.primary-nav + button.menu-toggle; section.hero > div.hero-copy + div.hero-art
cssLayers: Design tokens: colors, fonts, spacing, radii, shadows
suggestedHtmlCssStructure.recommendedCssApproach: Use semantic class names, CSS custom properties for design tokens, CSS Grid for section layouts, Flexbox for navigation and card metadata, and absolute positioning only for decorative or overlapping artwork.
